questions.q: What is the defining distinction between 'Responsiveness' and 'Responsibility' in public procurement?
options: Responsiveness relates strictly to price; Responsibility relates to quality
Responsiveness refers to the vendor's historical performance; Responsibility refers to their future plans

Responsiveness focuses on whether the submitted document conforms to the bid's exact rules and specifications; Responsibility focuses on whether the vendor has the capability and integrity to perform the work
There is no distinction; they are interchangeable legal terms
questions.explain: Responsiveness is about the bid itself (did it follow the rules, include forms, meet specs?). Responsibility is about the bidder (do they have the money, equipment, and ethical standing to do the job?).
